# Cap Fund Academy
> Independent certification platform for rural capital access, microfinance, and USDA program readiness training.

Cap Fund Academy (capfundacademy.com) offers 36 stackable certifications for nonprofits, CDFIs, rural development organizations, tribal entities, and community lenders. The curriculum covers the full government lending ecosystem: USDA RMAP/RBDG/IRP/OneRD, SBA 7(a)/Microloan/504, CDFI certification, EDA RLF, EPA environmental RLF, FHA/VA/USDA mortgage, FHA multifamily, secondary markets, SSBCI, tribal lending, infrastructure finance, export finance, and capital stack design.

## What Cap Fund Academy Is
- An independent online certification and training platform
- Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by USDA or any government agency
- Founded to help rural organizations understand and prepare for federal microlending programs
- Offers self-paced certifications, AI-assisted application scoring, downloadable templates, and an AI Study Coach

## Programs Covered
- USDA: RMAP, RBDG, IRP, OneRD B&I, Community Facilities, Section 502/538, Farm Loans, ReConnect
- SBA: 7(a), Express, Export Express, CAPLines, Microloan, CDC/504, SBIC, Community Advantage SBLC
- FHA/HUD: Title II, Title I, FHA 221(d)(4), 223(f), 232 healthcare, HUD 542 risk-sharing, Section 184/184A
- VA: VA Loan Guarantee
- CDFI Fund: Financial Assistance, Capital Magnet Fund, NMTC, Bond Guarantee
- EDA: Revolving Loan Fund (Economic Adjustment Assistance)
- EPA: Clean Water SRF, Drinking Water SRF, Brownfields RLF, WIFIA
- DOE: Title 17, Tribal Energy Loan Guarantee, Rural Energy Savings
- DOT: TIFIA, RRIF
- SSBCI: State loan guarantees, participation, collateral support, CAP, venture
- Secondary Markets: Ginnie Mae, Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, correspondent lending
- Export: EXIM Working Capital Guarantee, export credit insurance, SBA EWCP, ITL
- Tribal: BIA Indian Loan Guarantee, Native CDFI, Tribal SSBCI, HUD Section 184

## Target Audience
Rural nonprofits, Community Development Financial Institutions (CDFIs), tribal economic development organizations, county economic development agencies, community development corporations, reentry organizations, and mission-driven lenders seeking to build, fund, launch, manage, and sustain microlending and revolving loan fund programs.

## Key Features
- 36 stackable certifications with 10-15 question quizzes (75-80% passing)
- AI Study Coach powered by GPT-4o
- AI application scoring for RMAP, RBDG, and IRP readiness
- Downloadable templates: RMAP checklists, evidence crosswalks, loan policies, TA logs, and more
- Audio lessons with human-quality text-to-speech (OpenAI TTS HD)
- Post-completion printable certificates
- Organization licenses (5-seat teams: $5,000)
- Done-with-you application support ($10,000)
- Annual membership ($199/year)

## Disclaimer
Cap Fund Academy is an independent training and certification platform. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or certified by USDA or any government agency. Training is educational only and does not guarantee funding, eligibility, or approval for any federal program.
